dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. The South Saanich District bordered by the Lake District on the east coast of Vancouver Island. There are sketches and relief shading to show land cover and land forms. Has numbered plots of land corresponding to two tables of owner's names on the sides of the map. Some of the places and features named include Mount Newton, Saanich Inlet, Tod Creek, Cowitchen Head, Harro Strait, and Bazan Bay. There are roads and trails as well.
